newsitem.title: USA: Crown Resources wins mining ruling.
newsitem.headline: Crown Resources wins mining ruling.

text.p: Crown Resources Corp said on Tuesday that the U.S. Forest Service upheld a Final Environmental Impact Statement and a Record of Decision on the company's Crown Jewel Mine in northeastern Washington.

The action affirms the January 1997 decision to approve the Crown Jewel gold mine project and denies the four appeals filed in March by local and Washington State environmental groups, and the Confederated Tribes of the Colville Indian Reservation, the company said.

The Crown Jewel project is a joint venture between Crown and Battle Mountain Gold Co, which is earning a 54 percent interest in the project by funding development through to commercial production, with no capital repayment by Crown, Crown said.
The decision by the Forest Service, however, could be appealed to U.S. Federal District Court, the company said.
Crown said the process of obtaining the numerous permits required to begin mine construction is continuing, with all substantive permit applications having been submitted for approval.
